I am a 42-year-old farmer in Dedza with no schooling. My 0.08-hectare plot of beans is small but important for feeding my family. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not see the need to waste expensive chemical fertilizer on this plot when my maize needs it more. I will use manure from my animals to give the soil some strength, and I have kept local bean seed from last season that grows well here. Weeding and harvesting will take time, but my family can manage this small plot without hiring help.
